description: Stormcaller's Leggings Level 60 Bring the Skin of the Great Sandworm, 2 Idols of Strife, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest. Requirements: - Skin of the Great Sandworm - Idol of Strife x 2 - Ivory Scarab x 5 - Bronze Scarab x 5 - Brood of Nozdormu:
